name: Harvester
description: The Winterworks Harvester: a big, gentle prehistoric herbivore with a huge hammerhead-shark-like head, small friendly eyes at the ends of the hammer, a broad shovel mouth lined with rows of cropping teeth, a mustard-yellow furry body on four thick legs under a shaggy dark green mossy mantle, green fur fringes on the neck, thighs and tail, ferns and wildflowers in the moss. Painted like a vanilla mob (sniffer-style two-tone fur, a small palette). Saddle and saddlebag chests are separate bones the game shows or hides. Minecraft pixel units, density 2: exports 1:1 to a vanilla entity model.
